title: Telegram Public Channel Scraper output
description: Public channel messages in the dataset and a run summary in the key-value store.

messages.title: Public messages
messages.description: Saved messages with channel, ID, URL, date, plain text, views, media indicators, photo URLs, links, forwarding and reply indicators.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: OUTPUT record containing a report per channel (channel, messages, pages, error) and totals for requested, succeeded, failed and skipped channels, saved messages and attempted pages.
